text: 乔木排版（DSH 插件，网页客户端）：把 Markdown 笔记整理成适合公众号、X、知乎和小红书发布的文章与图文。它在 DSH 主界面提供排版编辑器、实时预览和发布窗口，可保存笔记、逐篇设置主题样式，并导出公众号富文本、独立 HTML 和长图。还支持公式与 Mermaid 图表渲染、封面设计，以及向浏览器扩展交接 X、知乎和小红书草稿。适合需要把 Markdown 内容转换为多平台文章的写作者。编辑和导出无需发布账号；发布到公众号需要平台凭据，其他平台需要 Qiaomu Clipper 和已登录浏览器。

Qiaomu Publish (DSH web plugin) formats Markdown notes for WeChat, X, Zhihu, and Xiaohongshu. It adds live preview, per-note themes, and publishing windows. Render math and Mermaid diagrams, design covers, and export rich text, HTML, or long PNG images. Browser drafts use Qiaomu Clipper.

想把一篇笔记导出成可以分享的长图或独立网页。
让 DSH 帮我把文章内容整理成小红书分页图文。
I want to format a Markdown note as a WeChat article and preview it live.
Can I turn my notes into drafts for X, Zhihu, or Xiaohongshu?
乔木排版提供公众号文章的实时预览，可为单篇笔记选择主题并调整排版样式。预览可从侧栏和命令打开。
乔木排版的功能「导出文章」：把排版后的内容导出为独立 HTML 文件或长图 PNG，生成的文件可在插件外打开或分享。
乔木排版的功能「多平台草稿」：为公众号、X、知乎或小红书打开对应发布窗口，检查并准备当前 Markdown 笔记，再提交或交接为草稿。
乔木排版的功能「笔记编辑」：在插件内打开 Markdown 笔记、实时预览修改并保存到选定的笔记工作区。
乔木排版 使用前须知：X、知乎和小红书草稿通过 Qiaomu Clipper 浏览器扩展交接，并要求目标浏览器已登录；公众号连接则在设置中配置凭据。
乔木排版 使用前须知：X、知乎和小红书交接会在本机启动仅绑定 127.0.0.1 的临时服务，完成、取消或超时后关闭。
Qiaomu Publish requires Qiaomu Clipper and a logged-in browser for X, Zhihu, and Xiaohongshu drafts.
怎样把公众号文章的样式复制出来，方便粘贴到编辑器？
I need to turn a Markdown article into a polished long image for sharing.

qiaomu-publish-dsh README · 乔木 Publish · DeepSeek Harness：> v0.1.3：DeepSeek Harness **0.2.2-rc.1** 兼容更新。[本次验证范围](docs/DSH-0.2.2-RC1.md)。

[English](README.en.md)

把 Markdown 笔记排成公众号文章、X 文章、知乎草稿和小红书图文。直接复用原版 Qiaomu Publish 的预览、42 个主题、排版控件、封面编辑与发布窗口。

qiaomu-publish-dsh README · 功能：- 原版实时预览、双向滚动、主题搜索与逐篇排版；字号、字体、行距、段距、主色、缩进、代码样式等沿用原控件。
- Markdown 文件、草稿恢复、附件导入、重命名保留主题、外部修改同步。保存会检查文件版本，避免覆盖其他编辑器的修改。
- 表格、提示块、脚注、代码、Wiki/Markdown 图片与笔记嵌入；内置 MathJax 和 Mermaid，公式与图表可随正文导出为图片。
- 复制公众号富文本、独立 HTML、长图 PNG；标题封面、图片选择、裁剪与字体配色直接沿用原版。
- 公众号多账号、直连／固定 IP 中转／自建 Bridge、新建和更新草稿、上传图片与封面、发布前检查、笔记属性记录。
- X／知乎／小红书沿用 Qiaomu Clipper v1 本机交接。六套小红书模板、分页、配色、字体、移除卡片、正文与话题限制均保留。

qiaomu-publish-dsh README · 安装：要求 DeepSeek Harness `0.2.2-rc.1`，Node.js 24.9 或更新版本。

1. 从 [Releases](https://github.com/joeseesun/qiaomu-publish-dsh/releases) 下载 tgz 和 SHA256SUMS，核对摘要。
2. 在 Harness 插件管理安装本地 tgz，或执行：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /absolute/path/qiaomu-publish-dsh-0.1.3.tgz
```

打开侧栏「乔木排版」。不需要连接任何发布账号即可编辑、排版和导出。

qiaomu-publish-dsh README · 笔记和原配置迁移：默认工作目录为 `$DSH_HOME/qiaomu/qiaomu-publish-dsh/notes`，未设置 DSH_HOME 时使用 `~/.dsh`。在该目录保存 Markdown 和附件，或通过「导入」选择文件。目录内相对图片路径保持不变；单篇 Markdown 上限 2 MB，单个附件上限 32 MB。

插件配置可指定 `notesDir`、`dataDir` 的绝对路径。选择已有笔记目录后，保存和发布记录会写入所选笔记；未选择的原 Obsidian 仓库不会修改。嵌入最多 8 层，同名附件无法唯一确定时明确报缺图，阻止不完整导出。

qiaomu-publish-dsh README · 笔记和原配置迁移：「导入」支持原 Publish 或乔木 Agent 的 `data.json`，保留主题、逐篇样式、账号配置与凭据 ID。不同宿主的凭据库不能直接共享，请在原版连接设置中重新填写 AppSecret／令牌；原 Obsidian 凭据不会删除。新凭据使用 macOS Keychain、Windows DPAPI 或 Linux Secret Service，配置 JSON 不保存密钥。Linux 需要可用的 `secret-tool` 和 Secret Service。

qiaomu-publish-dsh README · 发布到平台：公众号窗口使用官方 API或用户配置的中转服务；不操作微信客户端或微信内嵌页面。发布按钮只创建／更新草稿，不直接群发。

X、知乎、小红书需要已安装 [Qiaomu Clipper](https://github.com/joeseesun/qiaomu-clipper)，并在目标浏览器登录平台。交接时 Host 临时监听 `127.0.0.1` 随机端口，使用一次性取件令牌和会话令牌，完成、取消、超时或卸载后关闭。不会在编辑或预览时自动发送内容。

qiaomu-publish-dsh README · 验证范围：构建、包契约、原版业务逻辑及宿主边界均有测试。macOS 上已在独立 Harness profile 实测原版预览、公式／图表图片、HTML／长图导出、重命名、外部同步、发布窗口和六套卡片 PNG。

公众号真实账号和外部平台草稿发送没有在迁移验收中执行；传输与交接使用 fixture 和真实本机 socket 检查，不能替代真实账号验收。Windows/Linux 凭据实现尚未在对应系统实机验证。逐项记录见 [ADAPTATION](docs/ADAPTATION.md)。

qiaomu-publish-dsh README · 开发：```sh
npm ci
npm run check
npm pack
```

浏览器卡片验收页：`node scripts/qa-cards.mjs`，随后在 `build/cards-qa` 启动本地静态服务器。

MIT。原始代码来自 [qiaomu-publish](https://github.com/joeseesun/qiaomu-publish) 的 `4fbeae30017e1db4be95b7454620b30eae47ada8`。产品 CSS 保持字节一致；宿主边界与两项深色可读性修复有记录。依赖与字体许可证见 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。

[中文](README.md)

Format Markdown for WeChat, X Articles, Zhihu and Xiaohongshu using the original Qiaomu Publish UI: live preview, 42 themes, per-note typography, cover design/cropping and publishing dialogs.

qiaomu-publish-dsh README · Qiaomu Publish for DeepSeek Harness：Includes Markdown files and attachments, draft recovery, conflict-aware saves, rename with retained styling, external file updates, wiki/note embeds, footnotes, tables, code, bundled MathJax/Mermaid image rendering, rich-text copy, standalone HTML and long PNG export. Six original Xiaohongshu card templates retain pagination, fonts, palettes, card removal, body and topic limits.

qiaomu-publish-dsh README · Install：Requires DeepSeek Harness `0.2.2-rc.1` and Node.js 24.9+. Download the tgz and SHA256SUMS from [Releases](https://github.com/joeseesun/qiaomu-publish-dsh/releases), verify the digest, then install with the plugin manager or:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /absolute/path/qiaomu-publish-dsh-0.1.3.tgz
```

Open Qiaomu Publish in the sidebar. Editing and exporting do not require publishing accounts.

qiaomu-publish-dsh README · Files, settings and credentials：Notes default to `$DSH_HOME/qiaomu/qiaomu-publish-dsh/notes` (`~/.dsh` if DSH_HOME is unset). Optional absolute `notesDir` and `dataDir` plugin settings select another workspace. Saves and publishing metadata modify only notes in the selected workspace. Markdown limit: 2 MB; attachments: 32 MB; nested embeds: eight levels. Ambiguous or missing images block incomplete export.

qiaomu-publish-dsh README · Files, settings and credentials：Import original Publish or Qiaomu Agent `data.json` through Import. Themes, note styles, account configuration and credential IDs are preserved. Re-enter credentials in connection settings because the hosts use separate credential stores; the original Obsidian data and secrets are not removed. New secrets use macOS Keychain, Windows DPAPI or Linux Secret Service (`secret-tool` required), not configuration JSON.

qiaomu-publish-dsh README · Publishing：Original multi-account WeChat direct/relay/self-hosted Bridge clients, draft creation/update, image/cover uploads and note metadata are retained. This plugin uses APIs; it does not automate the WeChat client. It creates drafts, not mass sends.

qiaomu-publish-dsh README · Publishing：X, Zhihu and Xiaohongshu use [Qiaomu Clipper](https://github.com/joeseesun/qiaomu-clipper) and the user's logged-in browser. A temporary loopback listener serves one job using a one-time pickup token and session token, and closes on completion, cancellation, timeout or unload. Editing and previewing never submit content.

qiaomu-publish-dsh README · Validation and development：Original business tests, native host boundary tests, build and package checks are included. macOS Harness QA covers original UI, math/diagram images, HTML/PNG export, rename, external edits, publishing dialogs and real PNG generation for all six card templates. Live account submission was not performed; API fixtures and real loopback tests do not establish platform account acceptance. Windows/Linux credential backends are implemented but not device-tested here. See [adaptation evidence](docs/ADAPTATION.md).

qiaomu-publish-dsh README · Validation and development：```sh
npm ci
npm run check
npm pack
```

`node scripts/qa-cards.mjs` builds the local card export harness in `build/cards-qa`.

MIT. Adapted from [qiaomu-publish](https://github.com/joeseesun/qiaomu-publish), commit `4fbeae30017e1db4be95b7454620b30eae47ada8`. Product CSS is unchanged; native boundaries and dark-content readability fixes are documented. See [dependency/font notices](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).
